name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/<int:c_custkey> handler, function delete_customer(), the code explicitly executes "DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?" before deleting the customer. This matches the application-level child-row delete signal and qualifies because /api/orders/monthly-trend reads from orders, so deleting a customer also removes order rows needed by that endpoint, causing observable data loss.
